gloss_en: Kisses (neshikin) — the kabbalistic/Zoharic term for kisses as the mystical union of spirit with spirit (hitdabkut rucha be-rucha); in Likutey Moharan I:12, the spiritual kiss whereby the spirit of the Tanna cleaves to the spirit of one who studies his Oral Torah rulings in holiness (Yaakov kissing Rachel; 'his lips are lilies'). Not a physical kiss per se, nor any homograph of the root נש"ק (e.g., weaponry, nesheq).
